assets.notes: CODE across chest, tapered cape, pen-staff with white nib. Approved by eye (hero_34.png, hero_side.png).
White L-E-A-K on black ink body, clawed arms, drips, ink pool. Hovers on the pool by design.
Same family as scamp; erratic lunge variant. Stubby ink legs.

Art QA found two defects and both were fixed in the source: (1) the letter slab floated above the pool — fixed with a tapered ink skirt rising out of the pool; (2) the centred skirt swallowed the A/K row — fixed by shifting the skirt back (+Y) and moving the drips forward of its front. Re-verified by eye (leak_brute_34.png, leak_brute_side.png).

NULL across chest, POINTER down the cloak front, horns, claws, hollow white orb. Preview framing fixed (camera pulled back for the 3.6 m height) and re-verified (nullpointer_34.png, nullpointer_side.png).
